source.summary: GitHub Actions ‘Embedder footprint’ runs for PR #357 (branch fix/320-resource-validation at head daf55480a32bd26e89c499644a2044cbc425cd64 — the #320 change (resource type validation: structural type roots may carry handles to abstract resources that are part of the surface, (sub resource) export ascriptions mint fresh resource identities per instantiation, and own/borrow mismatches report the specific expected/found reason) merged with current main b20ed79513bbb12f6e4447158fd4028808ac129b (PR #353), with no merge conflicts; ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45598730533, 45598745727 and 45598759671 against the branch and pull-request run 45598638176, which built the same tree, produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #357 (#320, resource type validation gaps). The branch merged current main (merge commit daf5548, main at b20ed79513bbb12f6e4447158fd4028808ac129b — PR #353 (#318, split extern-name encodings (name prefix 0x02: implements / version-suffix / external-id) decode, and extern names are validated against the package-name grammar) on top of the main at d5af7b8e004daff28d1735657155d3df5802d8a3 the branch was based on); the merge was conflict-free, and its CI run on the merged tree tripped the gate on the twelve series of the three configurations that link telomere-component. Attribution was isolated by measuring current main alone three times (workflow_dispatch runs 45598772332, 45598789232 and 45598803018 on main at b20ed79513bbb12f6e4447158fd4028808ac129b; all three runs pass the gate against main’s checked-in baseline). Against the checked-in baseline, the main control is byte-identical on all 32 gated series. This PR’s own delta against the main control is confined to the same 12 series: in release, stripped file +2,832 B (component), +2,816 B (wasi) and +2,816 B (wasi-threads) and stripped .text +2,544 B in each; in release-size, stripped file +1,632 B / +1,648 B / +1,664 B and stripped .text +1,360 B in each. Every other configuration is byte-identical to main in both profiles. All twelve series exceed the checked-in baseline, so those twelve are re-baselined to the branch measurements. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the four branch samples and across the three main samples. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is now the release component stripped file series at +11.14% (2,433,656 B to 2,704,688 B), up from +11.02%; the release core-nosimd stripped file series is unchanged at +9.83% (1,275,448 B to 1,400,840 B). The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison.
